evidence: The ﬁlm thickness, density and roughness values were determined from X-ray re ﬂectivity (XRR; Panalytical X’Pert MPD Pro Alfa 1) measurements using the XPERT HighScore Plus-re ﬂectivity software for the data analysis. Grazing incident X-ray diffraction (GIXRD) measurements with the same instrument were carried out to con ﬁrm the crystallinity of the samples. The morphology and elemental distribution were characterised with a scanning electron microscope (SEM-EDS; Leo 1530 Gemini microscope equipped with a Thermo Scienti ﬁc UltraDry SDD EDS-system). The Er/(Er þ Yb) content ratio was measured by X-ray ﬂuorescence spectroscopy (XRF; PANalytical Axiosm MAX with Rh tube, 3 kW model). The up-conversion luminescence spectra were measured with an Avaspec-HS-TEC CCD spectrometer at room temperature. The materials were excited with an Optical Fiber Systems IFC-975-008 NIR laser (6 W; l exc ¼ 974 nm). Emission was collected at a 90 8 angle to the excitation and directed to the detector with an optical ﬁber (diameter: 600 mm). In the excitation path, a long-pass ﬁlter with a cut-off at 900 nm (Edmund Optics) was used to ensure a pure NIR excitation. In the emission light path, 900 nm ﬁlter (Newport, 10SWF-900-B) was used to exclude the scattered excitation radiation.
